name: Fennel Dauphinoise
assumptions: Recipe instructions indicate 2 ramekins, so yield is 2 servings
Total time is sum of 10 min simmer + 40 min bake + ~10 min prep/oven heat
Butter for greasing and Parmesan 'to serve' are included in ingredient list and classified conservatively
No wheat, eggs, fish, shellfish, nuts, peanuts, soy or sesame in listed ingredients
Milk, double cream, butter and Parmesan confirm dairy presence
All ingredients compatible with vegetarian and pescatarian diets
No gluten-containing ingredients listed; recipe is gluten-free
Dairy ingredients make it incompatible with vegan and dairy-free
instructions:
Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Put potatoes, fennel, and garlic in a medium non-stick pan. Pour in milk and double cream, season well and simmer gently, covered, for 10 mins, stirring halfway through, until potatoes are just tender.
Divide the mixture between 2 small (about 150ml) buttered ramekins and scatter with Parmesan. Bake for 40 mins until the potatoes are golden and tender when pierced with a knife. Snip the reserved fennel fronds over before serving.

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.assumptions: Raw potato flesh only; standard white potato values

ingredients.name: Fennel
ingredients.assumptions: 1 small fennel bulb ~200g edible trimmed weight (excluding tough outer stalks and core); raw fennel bulb values

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium garlic clove ≈3g peeled and chopped; standard raw garlic values

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.assumptions: 75ml semi-skimmed milk (density ≈1.03g/ml); standard cow's milk values

ingredients.name: Double Cream
ingredients.assumptions: 100ml double (heavy) cream (density ≈0.97g/ml); standard UK double cream values

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.assumptions: Small amount of butter used to grease two ramekins; standard unsalted butter values

ingredients.name: Parmesan Cheese
ingredients.assumptions: Grated Parmesan scattered on top of both ramekins (≈15g total); standard hard Parmesan values
